uncited: This method extends the standard NeRF formulation to perform object segmentation by simultaneously estimating scene geometry and predicting semantic occlusion masks.
*   Multi-view images $I_o$ with corresponding ground-truth semantic masks $P(r)$ for pixels $r$.
The network $F_\Theta$ takes positional encoding of $\mathbf{x}$ and direction $\mathbf{d}$ as input.
*   **Time Complexity:** Standard NeRF training complexity, dominated by the forward pass through the MLP for each sample point on each ray.
The addition of area encoding $p$ adds negligible computational overhead as it shares the same MLP structure.
The output layer size increases by 1 (for $p$) compared to standard color-only NeRF.
*   **Strengths:** Enables view-consistent segmentation by leveraging multi-view consistency and geometry-aware area encoding.
It addresses the challenge of segmenting objects in scenes with occlusions by integrating semantic information into the NeRF framework.
